=== Case 5 ===
ISSUE:
The `plus` option to `url_escape` changes more than encoding of spaces
The `plus` option to `tornado.escape.url_escape` added in https://github.com/tornadoweb/tornado/commit/7056d6fbd1c4778cf56177698d57152188203e0d for https://github.com/tornadoweb/tornado/issues/25 changes more than the documented space encoding. It also changes the encoding of forward slashes. That is, setting `plus=False` stops the encoding of `/` to `%2F`.

This is because the implementation of `url_escape` switches from `urllib.parse.quote_plus` to `urllib.parse.quote` internally, and they have different default values for their `safe` parameter. The latter defaults to `'/'` which means that forward slashes are not encoded.
